rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 1500

weights = np.where(np.arange(366) >= 274, 1.6, 1.0)  # busier Q4
days = rng.choice(366, size=n, p=weights / weights.sum())
discount = rng.choice([0,5,10,20,30], size=n, p=[.45,.15,.20,.12,.08])
p_return = 0.06 + 0.004 * discount   # returns rise with discount
caption: Seeded, with a busier Q4 and returns that rise with discount — planted so there's something to find.
